title: State of Punjab v. Gurmit Singh

content.caseIdentity: State of Punjab v. Gurmit Singh, (1996) 2 SCC 384
content.holding: Established that the testimony of a rape prosecutrix is equivalent to that of an injured witness; if it inspires confidence, conviction can rest entirely upon her sole uncorroborated testimony. Delay in lodging FIR in sexual offences is natural due to social stigma.
content.relevance: The primary locus classicus governing appreciation of prosecutrix testimony in Section 64 trials.
